summary: Retest of the two items left open in iteration_27. Both are FIXED. (1) liveUpdates.ts watchdog: it now counts ticks where the socket is not connected and, on the 2nd one in a row, runs socket.disconnect(); socket.connect(). New socket_round28_watchdog.cjs runs the same logic with a 2 s interval against an accept-then-close server (the stuck 'opening' state) and then a real socket.io server. Result: PASS. The watchdog reset at 4 s and 8 s, and the client connected at 8.0 s. During 7 more ticks while connected there were 0 resets and 0 disconnects. The control run (NO_WATCHDOG=1) recovered only at 20.3 s, through socket.io's own 20 s connect timeout. (2) server.py socket_bridge close code: bridge on 8019 with FLEET_API_UPSTREAM=http://127.0.0.1:8041. socket_round27_outage_long.cjs PASS: reconnected after an 8 s port-closed outage and after a 5 s HTTP-503 outage. New socket_round28_midsession_close.cjs, 4/4 PASS: (A) upstream TCP dropped mid-session gives the client 1011; (B) upstream close 1011 gives 1011; (C) upstream normal close 1000 gives 1000; (D) when the client closes, the bridge closes the upstream with 1000. The bridge log has 0 'Task exception was never retrieved' messages and no tracebacks. Regression: test_round25_bridge.py 14/14 and test_round26_bridge_ip.py 12/12 pass. socket_round25_bridge.cjs passes in websocket and polling modes: notes:updated and note:replied both arrive. Driver app preview (390x844): james logs in, the Home active trip banner shows, Active Trip opens, and the socket opens on wss://.../api/socket.io/. An admin note posted via the API appeared live without a reload. There were no console errors.
action_items: Optional, LOW: test_round25_bridge.py still does not delete its 'TEST_ bridge note' (this run's copy, id 47, was removed by hand).
critical_code_review_comments: liveUpdates.ts: a connected socket always resets downTicks, so a live socket is never reset. disconnect() followed by connect() tears down the Manager (_readyState goes to 'closed'), so connect() opens a fresh engine. The auth callback reads the token again on that new connection.

liveUpdates.ts (note): the 'stuck opening' state also clears itself after socket.io's 20 s connect timeout. The 60 s watchdog is a backstop for the cases where socket.io has really stopped. During a long real outage it restarts the backoff once every 60 s, which is harmless.
server.py: the done tasks' exceptions are now read, which fixes the 1011 code and stops the log noise. Cancelled pending tasks are not awaited, which is fine because cancellation does not log.
Environment (not app code): three old ts-node-dev processes (pids 8502, 19256, 90658) are running at about 100% CPU. They look like leftovers from earlier runs.
